meanings: 【名詞】紙、用紙（thin material made from wood pulp used for writing or printing）
【名詞】書類、文書、論文（documents, articles, or sheets with written information）
【動詞】～に壁紙を張る、～を紙で覆う（to cover walls or surfaces with decorative paper）
